title: Conquest Reforged Modpack (Fabric)
description: The official Conquest Reforged modpack, for Fabric!
body:
[![Conquest Reforged](https://i.imgur.com/zcirlvD.png)](https://conquestreforged.com)

      

> ### ⚠️ This is the Fabric modpack > Playing on Forge? Click the link below for the correct pack. > > > > **Memory:** allocate **6-8 GB (8064 MB)** to Minecraft. Under-allocating RAM is the single most common cause of crashes with this pack. ## What is Conquest Reforged? Conquest Reforged is an aesthetic Minecraft mod and the spiritual successor to the [Conquest_](https://conquestreforged.com/conquest-pack) resource pack, built for players who want to push their creative builds far past the limits of the base game. **This modpack** packages the mod together with everything it needs: the full block palette, connected-texture support, and the performance mods that keep it all running at a playable framerate.
### 18,000+ blocks and counting, with new sets added regularly ### 32× handmade, semi-realistic textures with elaborate CTM ### 1.20.1 Latest Version
## What the pack offers * **Thousands of handmade 32× textures** with elaborate connected textures * **Over 18k blocks**, with more being added regularly * **Enhanced foliage** with layer placement functionality and Better Grass * **Custom skybox and atmosphere**, including invisible lighting, particle effects and animated wildlife * **A growing [community](https://conquestreforged.com/serverslist/servers)** of creative builders and breathtaking group projects ## Connected textures With Continuity, every block is taken to the next level. Connected textures are pivotal to the Conquest Reforged experience, and OptiFine is **no longer** needed to get it (MC v1.19+).

## Handcrafted textures for every build Expanding on the beautiful 32× textures from Monsterfish's [Conquest_](https://conquestreforged.com/conquest-pack) resource pack, Conquest Reforged spans a wide range of thematic assets, usable in anything from Roman colonies to medieval villages to modern industrial facilities.
## What's inside
The mods that shape the experience
| Mod | What it does | |---|---| | [**Conquest Reforged**](https://modrinth.com/mod/conquest-reforged) | The main mod | | [**Continuity**](https://modrinth.com/mod/continuity) | Connected textures. We ship a custom build with added support for *material*-based connections | | [**ArdaGrass**](https://modrinth.com/mod/ardagrass) | Better grass | | [**Nuit**](https://modrinth.com/mod/nuit) | Enables the custom skybox | | [**Polytone**](https://modrinth.com/mod/polytone) | Custom biome colours and creative inventory management | | [**Puzzle**](https://modrinth.com/mod/puzzle) | Backports the newer model format and lifts model size limitations | | [**[EMF] Entity Model Features**](https://modrinth.com/mod/entity-model-features) | Custom entity models | | [**[ETF] Entity Texture Features**](https://modrinth.com/mod/entitytexturefeatures) | Custom entity textures, random and animated | | [**Mod Menu**](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) | In-game config screens for Fabric mods | This is the shortlist. The complete mod list for any given pack file — it varies by Minecraft version — is on the [Versions](https://modrinth.com/modpack/conquest-reforged-modpack/versions) tab.
## Getting started 1. Install the **[Modrinth App](https://modrinth.com/app)** — or use Prism Launcher, ATLauncher or any launcher that supports `.mrpack` files. 2. Search for **Conquest Reforged Modpack (Fabric)** and hit install. 3. **Give it memory.** Set the instance to **6144-8064 MB or more** before first launch — the block palette is large, and less RAM is the most common cause of crashes and stutter. 4. Launch, and start building. Running a server? You'll only need the Conquest Reforged mod, the rest of the mods in this pack are primarily client-side. ## Join the community

## Credits Conquest Reforged is built on Monsterfish's [Conquest_](https://conquestreforged.com/conquest-pack) original resource pack. Developed and maintained by **Conquest Studios**.
